name: Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help plan, promote and help out with teen and children's library programs. Help judge writing contests. Help with community outreach projects.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: RISE Youth Leadership Program
org: Tualatin Hills Park and Recreation District (THPRD)
what_you_do: Volunteer with park district programs and events. Give at least 80 hours of service within a year.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Online trainings are held monthly, with more before summer.

name: Camp LEAD
city: Near Suttle Lake, west of Sisters, OR
what_you_do: A week-long camp for young people with disabilities. Work about 21 hours on outdoor jobs like trail work and fuels reduction. Afternoons and evenings are for camp activities, and the camp teaches LEAD leadership lessons.
deadline_text: Applications are open for July 2027. The page says the deadline is in June but the day is not shown.

name: Go!-LEAD
what_you_do: A paid winter job training program for young people with different abilities. You take care of public parks and trails and learn about outdoor jobs.
deadline_text: Applications are closed now and will open in the fall.

name: Central Oregon Youth Conservation Corps (COYCC)
org: Heart of Oregon Corps, with the US Forest Service
city: Bend, Redmond, Prineville, Sisters, Madras, La Pine and Warm Springs, OR
what_you_do: Work in a crew on outdoor conservation projects on public lands with the US Forest Service. About 50 Central Oregon teens are hired each summer.
deadline_text: Applications are open for the cohort starting June 21, 2027. The exact closing date was not readable on the page.

grades: Middle and high school (high school camps run separately)
name: Lane Community College Summer Early College Camps
what_you_do: Free 4 day career camps on the Lane campus. You can try car repair basics, CompuCon computer science, Junior Chefs Academy or media arts.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed and most camps were full. Page says registration info is updated before each summer; check in spring.

name: Lane-Metro Youth Corps summer crew
org: Looking Glass Community Services (Riverfront School and Career Center)
what_you_do: Summer crew members pull out invasive plants. They gather and plant native seeds and plants, build small things and take down fences. They also help care for park sites.
deadline_text: Current-year dates not posted on the page. The page says the crew is a 9 week program at 32 hours a week, and to fill out the interest form for an application.

name: Looking Glass Youth Job Training Program
org: Looking Glass Community Services (Riverfront School and Career Center), funded by Lane Workforce Partnership
what_you_do: Case managers help with job search, resumes, career ideas and school goals. They place youth in a paid work trial with a local business.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the interest form any time.

name: Northwest Youth Corps Youth Camping Crews
what_you_do: Teens camp for the whole session. They plant trees, thin brush, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences on public land in the Northwest.
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Northwest Youth Corps Youth Urban and Community Forestry Crews (Eugene)
what_you_do: A 5 week day program. Crews of 8 youth and 2 adult leaders work on tree projects in city parks, public land and community gardens. They also get about 8 hours a week of training.
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Eugene Science Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers run exhibit demos and host shows in the planetarium. They read to young kids and help at STEM workshops and summer camps. They also care for the garden.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Openings vary by season.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (day program); rising 11th and 12th (residential program)
name: Student Academy to Inspire Learning (SAIL) at the University of Oregon
what_you_do: Free week long summer programs on the UO campus. Students pick a mix of subjects (like psychology, physics, business or English) and work with UO teachers. There is also year round mentoring and essay help.
deadline_text: 2026 summer programs were full. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Hawaii 4-H Youth Development
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa CTAHR Cooperative Extension Service
city: Oahu, Maui, Kauai and Hawaii Island
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or a special interest program. Do hands-on projects like gardening, animals, robots, public speaking or woodworking. Teens build leadership and life skills.
deadline_text: Oahu's 2026-27 4-H program year enrollment starts September 1, 2026.

name: State-Funded Paid Internships for Public High School Students
what_you_do: Students work for private companies. The jobs are in career and technical fields. In summer 2026, interns at the Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum learned to fix and restore aircraft. Interns at Aloun Farms worked in farm and office departments.
deadline_text: No application dates on the program page. The 2026 summer internships ended at the end of July. Outrigger Resorts planned interns at its Kona and Waikiki properties later in the year, with no dates given.

name: Hawaii DOE Student Summer Internships (DOE Offices and Schools)
what_you_do: Work a summer internship at a Hawaii DOE state office, a complex area office, or a school. Each internship has its own duties and hours.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications opened Mar 30, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Kupu Aina Corps
what_you_do: Paid green jobs in nature care, farming, trail repair and green tech. You work with host groups across Hawaii and get career help and certificates.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-2027 term are open now. Closing date not stated on the page.

name: Rep. Matsumoto High School Legislative Internship
org: Office of Hawaii State Representative Lauren Cheape Matsumoto
what_you_do: Help a state lawmaker's office during the legislative session. Some interns may continue through the end of the session after May.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.

name: Senator Schatz High School Internship Program (Hawaii)
org: Office of U.S. Senator Brian Schatz
what_you_do: Work with a U.S. Senate office from home. The internship is virtual, and the work is done outside school hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 application closed on Aug 19, 2026. The page says the 2027 to 2028 application will be posted in spring 2027.

name: UH Early College (College Classes at Your High School)
org: University of Hawaii System and Hawaii State Department of Education
what_you_do: Take college classes with other high school students, offered at your high school, online, or as a mix of both. A college professor or a qualified high school teacher leads the class. Classes at the 100 level and above earn high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Deadlines are set by each UH campus. Ask your counselor.

name: UH Running Start (College Classes for High School Students)
org: University of Hawaii System and Hawaii State Department of Education
what_you_do: Take a college class at a University of Hawaii campus while you are in high school. You earn high school credit and college credit.
deadline_text: Deadlines are set by each UH campus. Ask your counselor.

name: Working Theory Farm Youth Positions
what_you_do: Youth employees work on a farm that grows food for community members. The page does not list the daily tasks.
deadline_text: This season's youth applications are closed. The page says to check back in late January 2027.

name: Friends of the Library of Hawaii Volunteer
org: Friends of the Library of Hawaii
what_you_do: Help sort, price and sell donated books and other items. Volunteers also help with the big book sales.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Book sales are in January and June.

name: Hawaii Foodbank Warehouse Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteers check, sort and pack dry food, fresh produce and bread at the Honolulu warehouse. There are also monthly Saturday packings. They fill senior food boxes and Food 4 Keiki.
deadline_text: No deadline. 2026 Saturday packing dates are listed on the page. Reserve by email.

name: Hawaii Pacific Health High School Volunteer Program
org: Hawaii Pacific Health (Kapiolani, Pali Momi, Straub Benioff, Wilcox)
what_you_do: Volunteers work with patients and staff. They visit or read to patients, help at the info desk, help on patient care units or in the gift shop, or guide patients as navigators.
deadline_text: Student summer applications close in the beginning of April, and summer placement is limited. Other applications are taken as posted.

name: Hawaiian Humane Society Junior Volunteer
what_you_do: Teens ages 15 to 17 help care for shelter animals and help the community. Some roles let a junior volunteer work alone. Some roles need a teen to volunteer with an adult.
deadline_text: No deadline. Allow about 6 weeks for the application and training. Applications are kept for 6 months.

name: Teens4Animals Council
what_you_do: Council members plan and lead animal welfare events at school and in the community. They staff booths at Humane Society events. They speak up for animals. They can start an animal club at their school.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications are closed. The page does not say when the next application opens. The 2026 training was June 22 to 25, 2026.

name: Kupu Community Program
what_you_do: A year long Oahu program for youth who lack support. It starts with 6 weeks of outdoor land repair. Then you work toward a high school diploma or equivalency, with job training in food and events.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round.

name: Lieutenant Governor High School Internship Program
org: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii
what_you_do: Spend five summer weeks at the State Capitol, in person, and learn how state government works.
deadline_text: The 2026 internship ran June 15 to July 16, 2026. Its deadline was Apr 15, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.

name: Volunteer Program (high school students can apply)
what_you_do: Volunteers talk with the public. They help with current exhibits. They help families with activities on Community Sundays. They help at HoMA Nights. They also prepare mailings for members.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings depend on what each museum department needs.

name: ʻAha ʻŌpio o OHA
what_you_do: Spend six days in Honolulu with other high school students. The program is overnight, and OHA covers airfare, lodging and meals for chosen students.
deadline_text: The next program is listed as Summer 2027, dates to be set. The online application link says coming soon. No deadline is posted.

name: Summer Fun Junior Leader (Honolulu Parks and Recreation)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Teens help staff at Honolulu's city-run Summer Fun day camps for kids at parks across Oahu.
deadline_text: 2026 kid registration was May 11 to 15. Junior Leader sign up is through each site; 2027 dates not posted.

name: Summer Swim Aide (City of Honolulu pools and ocean sites)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards at city pools or ocean sites teach swim classes and keep swimmers safe. They also help run swim, paddle, surf and dive activities.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted online with no closing date listed. Current status not confirmed.

name: The Queen's Medical Center Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the hospital. Roles include gift shop help, guiding visitors, delivering gift baskets and other help for patients. There is also a High School Summer Student Program.
deadline_text: Dates not stated on the page. Call Volunteer Services (Mon to Fri, 8 am to 4 pm) for the next start.

name: UH Manoa Early College Scholars
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College
what_you_do: Take a UH Manoa college class, usually at your own high school. You earn high school credit and college credit, and you start a real college transcript.
deadline_text: Final deadlines: Spring 2027 is Nov 20, 2026. Summer 2027 and Fall 2027 are Apr 15, 2027.

name: Marine Science Investigations at the Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College and Hawaii Institute of Marine Biology
what_you_do: A week of hands on sea science on Coconut Island. You do reef surveys in the water, island walking tours and lab work on sea sounds, brains and reef life.
deadline_text: 2026 application opened in March for the June 1 to 5 program. 2027 not posted. Email summer.programs@hawaii.edu to get notified.

name: Medical Diagnosis and Treatment summer program (JABSOM)
org: University of Hawaii John A. Burns School of Medicine and Outreach College
what_you_do: A week long program for students who like health careers. It has body lab demos, clinical skills labs, practice dummies and practice patient talks.
deadline_text: The page says the application opened in March 2026 for the 2026 program. 2027 information not posted. Email summer.programs@hawaii.edu to be notified.

grades: Finished grade 10 or 11 (rising juniors and seniors)
name: UH Manoa Summer Scholar Program
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa Outreach College
what_you_do: High school students take UH Manoa summer classes. They learn with college students. They earn college credit.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Waikiki Aquarium High School Teen Educator Program
org: Waikiki Aquarium (University of Hawaii at Manoa)
what_you_do: Teens learn about Hawaiian sea life and practice talking with visitors about it. They build leadership and public speaking skills.
deadline_text: The page said Summer 2026 applications were open, with no closing date listed. Summer 2027 not posted yet.

name: Hawaii High School Model Youth Legislature (YMCA of Honolulu)
what_you_do: High school students practice how laws are made in a model youth legislature.
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not stated on the program page. See the state calendar link on that page.

name: Honolulu Youth Commission
org: City and County of Honolulu, Office of the Mayor
what_you_do: Commissioners speak for young people on Oahu. They advise the Mayor and the City Council. They meet at least once a month.
deadline_text: The online application portal is closed until 2027. New dates are not posted yet.

name: Honolulu Zoo Junior Leader Program
what_you_do: Teens help the Education team during Zoo Camp. They do outdoor science, guide younger campers and set a good example.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. First-time volunteers are asked to start in spring, fall or winter camp if possible.

name: Early College at UH Maui College
what_you_do: High school students take UH Maui College classes for college credit. Early College Dual Credit classes are taught to high school peers. Early Admit students take classes on the college campus.
deadline_text: Early Admit application periods: Fall Sept 1 to Aug 1; Spring Aug 1 to Dec 15; Summer Jan 1 to July 1. Dual credit deadlines are set by your high school.

name: Oregon Coast Aquarium Youth Volunteer (Exhibit Interpreter)
what_you_do: Teens work as Exhibit Interpreters. They talk with guests about sea animals and the ocean. Summer volunteers also get trips like behind the scenes tours and career ideas.
deadline_text: The page lists school-year info sessions on Thursday October 15 at 6:00pm (virtual) and Saturday October 17, 10:30 am to 11:30 am (in person), and school-year training on November 7, 14 and 21. The page gives no year for these. Summer training is in June 2027. Email volunteer@aquarium.org to be added to the interest list.

name: Ignite by 4-H Conference (Oregon delegation)
what_you_do: Join teens from across the country at a conference in Washington, DC. It has speakers and workshops on science, farming and healthy living. You make a plan for action in your community.
deadline_text: Applications close October 13, 2026 at 11:45 pm (the deadline was extended from October 1).

name: Oregon 4-H Ambassador Program
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Speak for 4-H at public events and to lawmakers. Help plan 4-H events. Volunteer at programs across the state, such as the Oregon State Fair.
deadline_text: Applications were due May 1, 2026. Finalists interview at Summer Conference in late June (2026: June 24 to 27).

name: Oregon 4-H Summer Conference
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Spend four days on the OSU campus in workshops taught by OSU faculty and 4-H volunteers. Meet teens from across Oregon and explore careers and college.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened May 15, 2026. Next year not posted.

name: Oregon 4-H Youth Development
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects like animals, robots, sewing, food saving or nature science. Clubs meet through your county Extension office.
deadline_text: The 4-H year begins October 1. Online enrollment opens the last week of September. The page was written for the 2025-26 year, so check the 2026-27 dates with your county.

name: Youth Tractor Safety Certification
city: Linn, Marion, Clackamas, Jefferson and other Oregon counties
what_you_do: Take a 22-hour course with online work, classroom time and tractor driving. It meets the Oregon Department of Agriculture rule for farm employers who hire minors.
deadline_text: Classes run in spring and summer. The 2026 classes ran March to June 2026. Next dates not posted.

name: Legacy Good Samaritan Medical Center Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteers help patients, families and staff. Roles include gift shop, patient escort, greeter and office help. They also include garden and pet therapy.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The page says to wait for the application to re-open if you want a different Legacy hospital.

grades: Rising 9th to 12th grade (rising 10th to 12th for writing and art)
name: Lewis and Clark Precollege Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take a summer program on campus. Subjects include health careers, data, theatre, studio art, writing and debate.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates for five programs are not set yet on the program page. The balance is due by May 1, 2027.

name: Multnomah County Library Teen Council
what_you_do: Teen council members meet twice a month and work with library staff to improve services. Members earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Ask your branch.

name: Multnomah County Library Volunteering
what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch. The roles vary by branch and change often. Check the volunteer page for open roles.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Allow 1 to 2 weeks for processing.

name: Multnomah Youth Commission
org: Multnomah County and City of Portland (Office of Community and Civic Life)
what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise the Multnomah County Board and Portland City Council. They advise on choices that affect young people. They push for a youth policy plan.
deadline_text: The page says applications were due April 18, 2025, and it was last reviewed February 20, 2025. The next cycle is not posted.

name: Northwest Youth Corps Portland Youth Community Crews
what_you_do: A 5 week day program. Crews of 8 to 9 teens plant trees, pull invasive plants, build trails and put up fences around Portland. They get a daily lesson, then go home.
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted; the 2027 application cycle is not posted. Dates may change.

name: OHSU Experience health careers day camp
what_you_do: A free 1 day camp at OHSU. It has hands on medical practice, talks from experts and a look at careers in medicine, nursing and research.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the OHSU Experience are now closed. It gives no reopening date. 2027 dates not posted.

name: OHSU Healthcare Volunteer Summer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at OHSU. They guide patients and families to appointments. Or they help kids in a clinic waiting room as Art Cart helpers (16+). Or they play music (14+, audition).
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says the 2027 Summer Program opens in January 2027.

name: Knight Scholars Program
what_you_do: High school students explore cancer research and care careers. First comes a 1 week intro at OHSU. Then 10 week programs mix lab or shadowing time with work in their home communities.
deadline_text: The page says there is no summer program in 2026 and to check back in the fall of 2026.

name: OMSI Camp Counselor (Camp Gray and Camp Hancock)
what_you_do: Summer camp counselors look after campers. They ride the bus to camp and stay in cabins. They lead games, cabin activities and campfires at an overnight science camp in Oregon.
deadline_text: The page says "Check back for Summer 2027!" It does not say whether counselor applications are open.

name: OMSI Teen Volunteer
org: Oregon Museum of Science and Industry (OMSI)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and up volunteer in the museum. They run exhibit activities in the Featured Exhibit Hall. They usher planetarium shows. They help at The Mezz teen space.
deadline_text: The page shows an Apply Now link and gives no deadline or application window. Interviews happen once a month.

name: The Mezz teen maker space at OMSI
org: Oregon Museum of Science and Industry (OMSI)
what_you_do: A free maker space for ages 13 to 18. It has music and recording, sewing, digital design, 3D printing, and photo and video. Teens work on their own projects, and staff can help.
deadline_text: Drop in during open hours. No deadline.

name: Oregon Food Bank Volunteering
what_you_do: Sort and re-pack food at the Portland and Beaverton sites. Help with seasonal garden projects and offsite food markets.
deadline_text: Sign up any time. Everyone must register ahead of time.

name: Oregon Humane Youth Volunteers (Portland campus)
what_you_do: Youth volunteers walk dogs and play with them. They also play with cats and small animals and help keep the shelter clean and healthy.
deadline_text: Next application window opens 11 am November 30 and closes 6 pm December 4. The page does not print the year. Windows typically open in December and again in June.

name: Oregon Zoo Wildlife Leaders
what_you_do: Teens volunteer at the zoo and lead activities for guests. They do hands on nature work around the Portland area and learn about zoo careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications have closed. Applications usually open in January and stay open about three weeks. Check the page for summer 2027.

name: Synapse: Health Career Explorations
org: Pacific University, Oregon Healthcare Workforce Institute (OHWI) AHEC
what_you_do: A week long summer camp with job shadows, practice cases, tours, workshops and panels. It helps students decide if a health care career fits.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran March 16 to May 25, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Portland Parks lifeguard and swim instructor certification
what_you_do: Take a lifeguard, swim teacher or water fitness teacher class with the city. Then apply to work at Portland pools. The lifeguard class gives First Aid, CPR and StarGuard Lifeguard certificates.
deadline_text: Classes run year-round. Register on the page; join the waitlist if a class is full. The page lists no class dates, so use each class link to see its schedule.

name: Portland Parks and Recreation seasonal youth jobs
what_you_do: Summer jobs in programs like swimming and summer camps. The bureau hires over 1,500 people ages 14 to 24 in a typical year.
deadline_text: Summer hiring usually starts in the winter, around January and February. Spring career fairs were held March 24 and 28, 2026.

name: PDX Youth@Work and SummerWorks
org: Worksystems, Inc. (with the City of Portland, City of Gresham and David Douglas School District)
what_you_do: Paid work with local employers, with hands on skill building. Some tracks focus on fields like building, clean energy, health care and making things.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The page does not say whether applications are open. The page links to the PDX Youth@Work Interest Form.

name: PNCA Pre-College summer art and design programs
org: Pacific Northwest College of Art (PNCA) at Willamette University, Community Education
what_you_do: 2 week Intensives and 1 week Studios. You draw, paint, animate and illustrate with PNCA teachers and artists. You build portfolio work. You meet admissions staff for a portfolio review.
deadline_text: Applications open fall 2026. 2027 dates: early application Mar 28, early registration Apr 11, application deadline May 2, registration deadline June 6 (rolling until full).

name: Portland Youth Conservation Crew
what_you_do: Teen crews work outdoors on trails, trees, community gardens or natural areas. They pull invasive plants, build trails and fences, make maps and care for trees.
deadline_text: The 2026 season ended. Next summer job applications will be posted early next year (watch the City of Portland job page).

name: YouthLine Peer Crisis Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer with a crisis line for young people. Complete 65 or more hours of training and shadowing first.
deadline_text: Orientations are held monthly. Dates are not listed on the program page.

name: Oregon House Honorary Page Program
org: Office of the Chief Clerk of the Oregon House
what_you_do: Honorary pages work on the House floor. They help with the daily work of the Oregon legislature at the State Capitol.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The application asks for a first, second and third choice of dates. The page does not say whether applications are open.

name: Oregon Humane Youth Volunteers (Salem campus)
what_you_do: Youth volunteers walk dogs and help care for animals. They clean kennels, check food and water, help with play and can foster.
deadline_text: Salem youth applications were open when the page was read. No deadline posted.

name: Salem Health Student Volunteers
what_you_do: High school students help staff, visitors and patients at the hospital after school or in summer. They learn about health care.
deadline_text: Application windows: school year July 1 to July 15; summer April 15 to May 1. The page does not give a year for these windows.

name: Camp College at Willamette University
what_you_do: A free 3 day, 2 night college camp on campus. You get a sample class, college search and application workshops, financial aid 101 and visits to nearby colleges.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due May 18, 2026, with answers by mid-June. 2027 dates not posted.

name: MA'O Organic Farms High School Break Internship
what_you_do: A week on the farm during school break. Do on-farm training, social and emotional learning, and explore college and career options. Reconnect with the land (aina).
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 Fall Break internship are closed. Spring Break applications are accepted in February for the March break. Fall Break applications are accepted in September.
